exercise.name: Single-Arm Lying Dumbbell Extension
library_steps: Lie on a flat bench holding one dumbbell straight above your shoulder.
Bend your elbow to lower the dumbbell beside your head.
Straighten your arm, finish your reps, then switch arms.
exercise.one_line_summary: Lying flat, one arm straight up with the upper arm tipped ~10 deg toward the head; only the elbow bends (to ~100 deg) so the dumbbell comes down beside the head, palm facing in. Triceps does the work; the other hand rests on the stomach.

setup.target: Flat on the bench, head on the pad, feet flat on the floor.
setup.why: Stable base; only the elbow should move.

setup.target: Upper arm vertical or tipped up to ~10 deg toward the head, held still all set.
setup.why: Moving the upper arm turns it into a pullover; tipping back keeps the shoulder flexed, which lengthens the long head.

setup.target: Neutral (palm facing in), thumb toward the head at the top.
setup.why: Lets the dumbbell pass beside the head instead of over the face.

setup.target: Rests on the stomach or holds the working upper arm.
setup.why: One-arm exercise; the free arm is not loaded.

muscles.emg: Lying extension reached 62% of the triangle push-up (S1). Shoulder-flexed (overhead) elbow extension grew the long head 1.5x more than a neutral arm (S2). The three heads activate alike at 60-120 deg elbow angles (S3).
not measured; hold the upper arm up

mistakes.what_it_looks_like: Elbow drops toward the head or the feet as the weight lowers.
mistakes.why_it_matters: Shoulder takes over; the upper arm must stay still.

mistakes.what_it_looks_like: Weight comes down over the nose instead of beside the ear.
mistakes.why_it_matters: Safety; library cue is beside the head.

sources.citation: Boehler B, Porcari JP, Kline D, Hendrix CR, Foster C, Anders M. 2011. ACE-sponsored research: best triceps exercises. ACE Certified News, Aug 2011.
sources.what_it_gave: Triceps EMG as % of triangle push-up: kickbacks 87, dips 87, overhead extension 76, lying barbell extension 62. Upper arm kept stationary in every extension.

sources.citation: Maeo S, Wu Y, Huang M, et al. 2023. Triceps brachii hypertrophy is substantially greater after elbow extension training performed in the overhead versus neutral arm position. Eur J Sport Sci 23(7):1240-1250.
sources.what_it_gave: Overhead arm: long head +28.5% vs +19.6% neutral; whole triceps +19.9% vs +13.9% after 12 weeks.

sources.citation: Akima H, Maeda H, Koike T, Ishida K. 2021. Effect of elbow joint angles on electromyographic activity versus force relationships of synergistic muscles of the triceps brachii. PLoS ONE 16(6):e0252644.
sources.what_it_gave: Medial, lateral and long heads did not differ at 60, 90 or 120 deg elbow angles.

Back on the pad, feet on the floor
